title: Review
subtitle: Pick up where your questions left off.
inbox_help: Move a chat to a course to keep its questions together. Start by creating a course or linking Moodle.
inbox_empty: No unsorted chats yet. Questions from your chats will appear here.
recent_help: Every question is a starting point, even when nothing needs review yet.
recent_empty: Ask a few questions in a course chat. Your question summaries will appear here.
weak_help: A few ideas worth another look, at your own pace.
weak_empty: Nothing needs review right now. You can still revisit Recently asked.
evidence_rule: Asking a question alone never marks a weak point. We look for difficulty across different days, or a clear misconception, or a wrong attempt followed by saying you do not understand. Showing understanding moves it out of this list. These are suggestions, not a measure of your ability.
evidence_empty: No evidence on this page. Load more to look further.
placeholder: Your selected concepts are ready. Choose a scope to generate review notes or a test.
draft_save_failed: Your latest choice could not be saved yet. It stays on screen and we will keep trying.
graded_earlier: This question was already graded with your earlier answer. That answer stays final.
error: Could not load or save your study memory. Please try again.
offline: Your provider is offline. Saved questions are still available. Reconnect and try again.
budget: Memory collection is paused by your review budget. Check your limits, then try again.
erase_confirm_copy: This permanently removes study courses, summaries, evidence, and review artifacts. Your chats remain.
chat_excluded: This chat is excluded from study memory.
memory_disclosure: Study memory is stored on this device. While it is on, after each answer in a chat, VStudy sends one extra request to the provider and model you are chatting with. It contains a limited excerpt of the conversation (up to the last 24 messages, including the tutor's replies, which may quote your documents) and your course, unit and concept names. That request uses your own quota or credit. When you create review content, excerpts from your course materials are sent too. Turn this off or erase it any time in Settings > Privacy. Chats you exclude are not recorded. Review budgets cover review calls; chat and document processing have separate limits.
scope_dates_help: Uses local calendar dates in this time zone, up to 366 days.
scope_dates_invalid: Choose an end date after the start, within 366 days.
scope_weak_help: Use the concepts currently suggested for review in this course.
scope_documents_help: Choose documents already attached to this course.
scope_empty: No choices yet. Add course materials or try another scope.
commit_notice: Submitting locks only this answer and shows its feedback immediately.
question_reported: Question reported and excluded from review updates.
results_counts: {{matched}} answers matched out of {{reviewed}} reviewed. {{revisit}} worth another look.
confirm_notice: After finishing the test, confirm separately to update your review list. Reported questions are excluded.
review_list_updated: Your review list has been updated.
choose_provider: Choose an available model in Settings to generate from your materials.
needs_sources: No sources resolved. Choose documents attached to this course, then generate again.
generation_budget: Generation is paused. Check your review budget and model pricing, then try again.
generation_offline: The provider is unavailable. Your saved work is still here. Reconnect and try again.
generation_failed: Could not finish generating. Your materials are safe. Try again.
generation_infeasible: This scope needs more concepts for a mixed test. Select additional course materials.
interrupted: Generation was interrupted. You can try again when you are ready.
delete_artifact_copy: This permanently removes this review and its attempts from your review list. Cancel to keep it.
validation_notice: checked for structure and sources, not guaranteed correct
artifacts_empty: No saved reviews on this page. Choose a scope to get started.
consent_done: Study memory is on. You can change this any time in Settings > Privacy.
assumption_sources_omitted: Some sources were left out to keep this review within its size limit.
assumption_excerpt_limited: Only the first part of {{document}} was used.
assumption_undated_units: Units without dates were placed by when you asked: {{units}}

bounded_session_other: Reviewing {{selected}} of {{total}} concepts; {{count}} left for another session
